proposed_relationship: Combining lipid nanoparticles with modified-nucleoside chemistry in synthetic mRNA could enable efficient delivery and translation of viral surface protein-encoding mRNA in cells.
mechanism: The use of lipid nanoparticles would allow for efficient delivery of the synthetic mRNA into the cytoplasm of cells, while the modified-nucleoside chemistry would reduce TLR recognition and increase translation of the mRNA, potentially leading to the production of viral surface proteins such as the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein. This could trigger an immune response and potentially lead to the production of neutralizing antibodies.
constraint_released: The combination of these two technologies could release the constraint of conventional vaccine platforms requiring months to years of manufacturing scale-up.
